notes: Boot no longer scans the whole event log, and archived threads' rows leave the hot file: a cold SQLite file beside temp-code.db, an auto-archive sweep after seven idle days, and a session list that carries only live threads. folds.ts sweepFolds opened every launch with `SELECT session_id, MAX(seq) FROM events GROUP BY session_id` over 7.5M rows (6–7 s on the main thread, the "no projects or threads" hang); Store.maxSeqs is now one correlated MAX(seq) index seek per unarchived session (db.ts), and the sweep skips archived sessions outright. db.ts attaches `temp-code-cold.db` (same events schema, PK (session_id, seq)) to the connection and keeps `sessions.cold` as the truth of where a session's rows are: events/eventsRange/eventsAfter/hasUserText/maxSeq/appendEvent route by that flag, searchEvents walks the cold file only with `archived: true`, deleteSessionTree clears both, and a reader hitting a half-moved session finishes the move first so it never sees a split log. moveToHot runs inside updateSession whenever archived flips false (the archive toggle and unarchive-on-send in sessions.ts both land there), one transaction before the turn runs; moveToCold is batched by cold.ts ColdMover, which drains `coldBacklog()` (archived sessions still hot) in 5k-row transactions with a yield between them, kicked after boot, after each sweep and by every setArchived(true), and resumable because a half-moved session is in the backlog again and the copy is INSERT OR REPLACE. sweepArchive (cold.ts) runs after the fold and mirror backfills and then hourly: it archives every unarchived member of a tree whose newest touch is older than `archive.idleDays` (settings table, default 7) unless any member is pinned, running/starting/waiting/paused/watching, has queued messages or sits in a saved workspace snapshot's tabs (openSessionIds over every `renderer.workspaceSnapshot.v1*` row), and drops each one's checkpoint dir through the new CheckpointStore.discard. session.list takes `{ archived?, projectId? }` and returns unarchived sessions by default (registry.list still indexes every row so a child of an archived root decorates right); the renderer store (tcserver/store.ts) fetches archived metas per scope on demand — ShellTitleBar asks for the selected project's for the Archived shelf, searchSessions with includeArchived asks for all, and peekSession/loadSession/getSession fall back to ensureMeta for an id the live list lacks — and a resync re-lists the loaded scopes and keeps pushed archived metas. Tests: db-cold (cold file on disk, move both ways, every reader falls through, appends to a cold session, unarchive moves back inside updateSession, batched move settles for a reader, idempotent resume, delete clears both files, boot scan ignores archived and cold, list filter), cold (archivable skip rules and the idle window, openSessionIds, ColdMover drain/resume/unarchive-mid-move/re-kick, sweepArchive through a real registry with checkpoint discard, the settings window), store.test (boot list carries no archived threads, ensureArchived per project, ensureMeta, pushed archived metas survive resync). Measured on a copy of the 4.0 GB prod database (7.47M rows, 4,504 sessions, 1,702 archived) in one isolated dev instance: fold-backfill 6–7 s → 716 ms on the first boot with a cold page cache (headless: maxSeqs 425 ms cold / 11 ms warm, sweepFolds 24.5 ms); first-session-list 2,802 metas on that boot and 507 after the sweep (session.list 17 ms; the archived list of 3,997 metas 35 ms, only when asked); the 38,279-row thread xP2XWLlAUw-Z (archived, so served from cold) tail-40 in 9 ms, whole log 203 ms, openSession → first blocks 119 ms; app.readThread on an archived 4,925-row thread 10 ms; moveToHot of the 38k-row thread (unarchive-on-send) 180 ms, moveToCold in one transaction 218 ms; the first-boot migration moved 1,702 threads / 2.26M rows in 33 s in the background with 20k-row batches (loop max ~200 ms per batch, hence the 5k default), the sweep archived 2,295 trees in 70 s, and the hot file ended at 594k rows with 6.88M in cold and the checkpoints root at 17 dirs instead of 2,986. No VACUUM: the hot file keeps its size and reuses the freed pages.
